name: RotateByQuaternion (rotates a 3-vector by a quaternion in place)
notes: Lane AJ. Hooked (not yet run in-game). Test SimGeometry_RotateByQuaternion: 30,000 cases, ordinary values and wild bit patterns (infinities, zeros, denormals) with canaries around the vector.
